description: Grumman OV-1C Mohawk AE-021 (c/n 136C), withdrawn 1996 and received by the museum December 1992 per the preservation blog; displayed in the museum grounds.
Bell OH-13H AE-396 (c/n 1660, ex US Army 55-4631), used as a training aid at the Escuela General Lemos before retirement; displayed at the museum.

Bell UH-1H AE-421 (c/n 13843) fuselage, believed to be the airframe left over when AE-421 was rebuilt as Huey II AE-466; shown in the Sala Malvinas (photographed March 2019). A UH-1H is also displayed in the museum gardens.
Agusta A109A Hirundo AE-336 (c/n 7150) of Argentine Army Aviation; displayed at the museum (photographed March 2019).
Aérospatiale SA 315B Lama AE-385 (c/n 2424); displayed at the museum (photographed March 2019).
Cessna 207A AE-224 (c/n 20700482) of Argentine Army Aviation; displayed at the museum (photographed March 2019).
Aérospatiale AS332B Super Puma AE-525 (c/n 70) of Argentine Army Aviation; added to the museum display, photographed 25 May 2024.
